messages:
sarah.g: Quick Q — we have a manager swap for Raj (eng) effective 2025-06-01. He was mid-cycle for a promotion. Does the evidence window / recommendation follow the original manager or the new manager? Also what's the policy for equity proration and retro pay? cc @payroll-bot @ella

mike_h: Short answer — evidence & decision ownership follow the manager who submitted the packet. If the new manager wants to take ownership, they need to explicitly adopt within 10 business days. See the midcycle playbook link: https://redwood.internal/people/midcycle-guide (internal).

ella: Adding specifics: People Ops prefers a handoff within 2 weeks of the change. If the change happens before the decision cutoff, we can proceed with the original packet. After the cutoff, the new manager must re-ack and confirm evidence. For equity: grant approvals are evaluated at issuance date; proration is handled by payroll based on effective date. Retro pay requires the payroll backdate form + final signoff.

raj: As the IC — will my promotion slot survive the manager swap? I already had peer + TL feedback compiled.

dana: Incoming manager here — happy to adopt if that's standard. What exact actions do I need to take to adopt?

sarah.g: Here's the simple handoff checklist (paste for clarity):
```
1) New manager emails people-ops@redwood.com with subject 'Handoff: <IC name> — adopt packet'
2) Attach the existing evidence packet (same format) and confirm you reviewed it
3) New manager replies to the original submission thread with +1 or resubmit edits within 10 business days
4) People Ops confirms decision owner and locks the packet if within the cutoff window
5) If retro pay is requested, complete payroll backdate form and provide manager signoff
```

sarah.g: Note — decisions are locked 5 business days before payroll cutoff for that cycle. If locked, adoption still possible but will delay payout to next run.

payroll-bot: payroll note — proration & retro calculations done in monthly run. Standard effective date alignment is 1st of month; exceptions need a payroll case and exec approval.

raj: Thanks. If effective date is 6/1 and payroll aligns to 1st, will I receive retro for May?

mike_h: You would only receive pay from 6/1 onward unless we backdate to 5/1. Backdating to previous month requires exec approval + payroll case; not typical.

ella: TL;DR: New manager can adopt within 10 business days, evidence stays with packet unless edited, equity issuance follows approval date, and retro requires the payroll backdate form + signoffs.

sarah.g: I'll open a formal handoff ticket and tag payroll and comp ops so nothing falls through. :thumbsup:

dana: Thanks — I'll send the adoption email and the reviewed packet tonight.

payroll-bot: Ticket PR-4621 created for backpay tracking (case ID PR-4621).
